answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 41391 Country: India Title: Dream Question: I went to Jamah for 40 days last year. I spent those days quite well Alhamdulillah. In last 10 days, I saw a good dream at about Zuhr time. I saw that I was in a shining masjid glittering and my family members were sitting in circle as we do in talim, then I searched for my father. He took hold of my hand and told me that come meet a person. I went along with him. He went downstairs and there I saw Prophet in white in good form. Then Prophet (pbuh) put his hand forward to shake hands with me. I hesitated a bit but then prophet smiled and so I shook hand with him. Then a voice came from back saying Allahuakbar and then I got up from my sleep. Please explain me this. But I have told this dream to many people. Will this affect dream interpretation? Answer ID: 41391 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1736/1405/B=1433) In-shaAllah, going in Jamah for forty days shall bring you good result. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
